title.en: Recurrent fungal infections and clipping outcomes

text.en: Several cat owners report that their indoor felines contracted severe ringworm infections after haircuts, requiring lengthy and costly veterinary treatments. In contrast, longtime clients praise the soft finish and cute cuts achieved on their cats, though recent complaints regarding fungal transmission heavily outnumber positive styling feedback.

title.en: Critical hygiene and clipper sanitation concerns

text.en: Multiple reviewers express strong alarm over sanitation standards, reporting that grooming clippers were shared between cats without proper disinfection. Clients urge management to overhaul sterilisation procedures, noting that strict indoor pets developed lesions specifically where unsterilised trimming blades made contact with their skin.

title.en: Divergent views on communication and care

text.en: Customer sentiment regarding groomer Debbie is sharply divided. Devoted pet owners regard her as an intuitive handler who calms shy felines and offers helpful dietary advice. However, other clients describe dismissive, argumentative responses and an unwillingness to accept accountability when post-grooming health issues were reported.

q.en: What pet grooming services are offered at Urban Aristocats?

a.en: The salon offers specialized cat grooming, full haircuts, bathing, and feline boarding alongside dog grooming services.

q.en: What sanitation concerns have clients raised about this facility?

a.en: Multiple reviewers reported that their indoor cats developed ringworm after appointments, citing concerns over clipper disinfection between animals.

q.en: How do longtime clients describe the handling of shy cats?

a.en: Longtime patrons praise Debbie's patience with anxious cats, noting she successfully handles shy or nervous pets during baths and trims.

q.en: Are dog grooming services also available at this salon?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention having their dogs groomed alongside cat services at the shared Preston Road location.
